ns2:section.sectionText: Topics in Number Theory. In this course we will study several fundamental topics from number theory in which tools from different parts of mathematics are used. We will review many of these tools as we go along, so the course will be mostly self-contained. There will be little overlap between this course and the standard undergraduate course in number theory. Prerequisite: Math 417 or Math 427. Additional information about this class can be found in the Math 428 flyer in https://go.math.illinois.edu/advising-forms . To request approval, email mathadvising@illinois.edu <mailto:mathadvising@illinois.edu> with subject line Math 428 and include your name, netid, UIN, and relevant background/prerequisites completed.
